test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly describes an ion?

options.text: An atom or group of atoms with a net electric charge
An atom with more protons than neutrons
A neutral molecule formed by ionic bonding
A molecule that has gained or lost neutrons

solution:
The correct answer is __**An atom or group of atoms with a net electric charge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Definition of an Ion:** An ion is an **atom or group of atoms** that has gained or lost electrons, resulting in a **net electric charge**. This can be a positive charge (cation) or a negative charge (anion).
 
• **Formation of Ions:** Ions form when an atom or molecule either **loses or gains electrons** to achieve a stable electronic configuration, often following the octet rule.
 
• **Types of Ions:**
 
 
• **Cation:** Formed when an atom loses electrons, resulting in a positive charge. Example: Na⁺ (Sodium ion).
 
• **Anion:** Formed when an atom gains electrons, resulting in a negative charge. Example: Cl⁻ (Chloride ion).
 
 
 
• Misconcept
